Today, most of the business owners (irrespective of the volume of business and their global reach) are confronted with the rising operating expenses, and therefore eternally searching for solutions that would require them to pay only used services and not the unused ones. AWS, somewhere, has emerged out of this concept, and therefore deals with on-demand cloud computing resources and services, thereby having the business owners pay only for the services they avail and not for everything that the association offers. Get certified in Cloud Computing with Amazon Web Services Course at 3RI Technologies. AWS, in layman’s terms, resembles a solution tailored to the industry’s requirements, thus rendering the static ones redundant. It is cost-effective, and with its functional efficiency, it is soft on time as well! This blog intends to acquaint people with the significance of pursuing AWS training in Pune and why they should choose 3RI Technologies as their educational partner for the AWS Cloud Practitioner Training . With an ever-growing base of more than 1 million customers in over 190 countries, AWS is one of those fastest-growing business applications and is slated to undergo even more exponential growth in the years to come. However, its growth as a business application needs to be complemented by the growth in the number of professionals adept at AWS and its applications, and that’s exactly where this 3RI AWS training in Pune comes from! It emphasizes learning the most practically relevant and latest concepts associated with AWS. 3RI Technologies has developed this course intending to augment the AWS expertise of existing software developers, project managers, system administrators that are keen on deploying applications on AWS, solutions architects, etc. Besides the competitive course content, this course also involves a challenging real-world project that will put the students to the test and bring out the best in them. Here’s the course outline of the 3RI AWS certification course in Pune. 3RI Technologies AWS Training in Pune | Comprehensive AWS Certification Course in Pune This training program is a 3 step course that includes the basics, the core course, and the project work. AWS Basics : Linux Basics and Storage Basics AWS Course Curriculum : Introduction to Cloud and AWS, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud, Identity and Access Management Techniques (IAM), S3, SNS, SWF and SQS, Networking: Setting up VPC and NAT, AWS Databases RDS and Dynamodb, Application Services. Project Work : Project Work, Big Data Solutions, Bonus Brief Introduction to Docker Qualifying to pursue this course requires you to be equipped with the fundamentals of network concepts, and cloud computing concepts.
